title: Heavenly Dao Puppet
next_chapter_hook: When that name transmitted from the Heavenly Eye's consciousness, Chen Ji froze entirely—the progenitor of the Chen bloodline was actually the mastermind behind all of this.

text.content: The moment Su Qingyao stepped into the vortex of fate, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms suddenly scorched hot, as if sensing something indescribable awakening. He raised his gaze to see those eyes in the depths of the Void slowly widening, and within the pupils seemed to reflect another deeper layer of darkness. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying an unprecedented gravity: "It has arrived... faster than anticipated." Chen Ji gripped the fragment tightly, his knuckles white, the unease in his heart growing stronger—this was not merely the awakening of the Heavenly Eye, but something of a higher existence peering through its gaze.

The third eye of the Heavenly Eye finally opened completely, the pitch-black pupil reflecting Chen Ji's form, only to shatter into countless fragments the next instant. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: "Impossible... how could it possess consciousness? This is clearly just a puppet!" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, coldly saying: "What do you mean?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before finally revealing a shocking truth: "Ten thousand years ago, when the Tianji Record first appeared in the world, the Heavenly Eye was merely a surveillance tool projected by Heavenly Dao's will—a puppet without self-awareness. But now, there is clearly its own resolve in its gaze!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at that eye, words emerging slowly: "What are you looking at?" The Heavenly Eye's pupil suddenly constricted, and that consciousness from deeper within actually responded: "Me? I'm watching a chess game that ended long ago." Chen Ji's entire body shook—this was the first time the Heavenly Eye directly spoke to him! Mo Xiansheng urgently said: "Be careful! This thing can directly invade consciousness!" But Chen Ji instead stepped forward, a cold smile curling at his lips: "Since it's a chess game, then let me ask—where is the Chess Player?"

text.content: In the depths of the Heavenly Eye's pupil, a bizarre golden ripple suddenly rose. That was not its own light, but some deeper, more ancient force manipulating every trace of its emotional fluctuation. Chen Ji's pupils tightened—he saw it! In the depths of the Heavenly Eye's consciousness, a vague figure stood faintly. The figure held a pen in hand, its tip dipped in blood-like ink, writing something in the Void. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned sharp: "That is... the Writer?! The one who manipulated everything ten thousand years ago?!"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered the Writer behind the Heavenly Eye. That vague figure was writing his fate in the Void. At this moment, should he confront and question directly, or secretly lay out his own scheme?

choices.description: Strike that figure directly with the power of the Tianji Record, forcing it to reveal itself
choices.visible_reward: Force out the Writer's true identity
choices.risk_hint: May expose all abilities of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh. The final thread of power from the Tianji Record Fragment condensed in his palm, and he fiercely blasted it toward that figure. As the light exploded, that figure finally revealed its outline—it was an elder dressed in ancient Chen family attire, with features bearing three-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji!

choices.description: Suppress the shock, pretend not to have discovered anything, secretly use the Tianji Record to record that figure's characteristics
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the Writer without exposing oneself
choices.risk_hint: The Writer may have already sensed it

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the surging emotions, his expression unchanged as he took a step back, secretly activating the Tianji Record. That figure seemed to sense something. The pen's tip paused and turned in his direction—and in that instant, Chen Ji saw the appearance of that pen clearly. It was the Chen family's ancestral Spirit Artifact, the "Destiny Plunder Pen"!

dialogue.content: The Writer slowly raised his eyes. A flicker of surprise and... nostalgia? appeared in those turbid pupils. His voice was aged yet majestic, yet carried an unnoticeable tremble: "You child... actually managed to see through this layer of illusion." Chen Ji clenched his fists, coldly saying: "Who are you?" The elder smiled faintly. That smile seemed somewhat kind in Chen Ji's eyes, yet sent a chill through his entire body: "Who am I? The third page of the fragment in your arms should have my portrait." Mo Xiansheng cried out: "Impossible! The third page was lost long ago!" The elder shook his head and sighed: "It was never lost... it has always been here, guarding my final obsession."

text.content: As the elder's words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment turned pages on its own. Chen Ji stared in horror as on the originally blank third page, a portrait slowly emerged. The person in the painting was precisely this elder before him, and beneath the portrait's inscription read: "Chen Family's First Generation Family Head, Chen Tianming—Tianji Record's First Writer." Chen Ji's mind exploded with a thunderous roar, ears ringing. He stared fixedly at those words, nails almost piercing his palms. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: "Chen Tianming... that was the founder of the Chen family ten thousand years ago, and also... the first person to leave the Tianji Record in this world!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down, yet his voice couldn't help but quiver: "So... the catastrophe ten thousand years ago, the list that caused countless geniuses to fall—all written by you?" Chen Tianming nodded, his gaze carrying a trace of pity: "By me." Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, eyes blazing with fire: "You destroyed countless people's lives, just for..." Before he could finish, Chen Tianming raised his hand to interrupt him: "You think I wanted to?" A bitter smile appeared on the elder's face, "Ten thousand years ago, an existence more ancient than me found me. It gave me two choices—become its chess piece, or watch the entire cultivation world be destroyed by its own hands. I chose the former, yet spent ten thousand years arranging, only to wait for a chess piece that could break the局.

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming revealed the truth of ten thousand years ago—he was merely a chess piece coerced by an even more ancient existence. So, should one choose to trust this ancestor's arrangement, or question whether this is all another trap?

choices.description: Chen Tianming is after all an ancestor of the Chen family, and has been arranging things for ten thousand years. Perhaps cooperation is possible.
choices.visible_cost: May become a chess piece again
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on Chen Tianming's ten-thousand-year layout
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming's words are difficult to distinguish between truth and falsehood

text.content: Chen Tianming's face showed unprecedented gravity: 'It calls itself the 'Origin of Heavenly Dao,' the will itself of this world. Ten thousand years ago, it chose me; and ten thousand years later, it chose you—because the Tianji Record has determined that you are the true game-breaker.'

choices.description: Chen Tianming's words are too coincidental, possibly a more sophisticated deception, must not be trusted lightly
choices.visible_reward: Not expose one's true thoughts, preserve trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming may become furious because of this

text.content: Chen Ji's expression revealed nothing, he only said calmly: 'What the ancestor speaks... Ji'er needs time to digest.' Chen Tianming gave him a deep look, then suddenly smiled: 'You child are far more cautious than I was at your age. Very well, it's time to show you the truth.' With that, he waved his hand, and the Life Tribulation Pen transformed into flowing light, merging into Chen Ji's brow center!

The moment the Life Tribulation Pen entered his body, a flood of information surged into Chen Ji's mind—Chen Tianming's ten-thousand-year layouts, calculations, and the true appearance of the terrifying existence known as the 'Origin of Heavenly Dao.' It was an entity without physical form, only consciousness, born from the Heavenly Dao's will of this world, yet one day it developed self-awareness, thereafter viewing all things in the world as its chess pieces. Chen Tianming's voice echoed in his mind: 'Ten thousand years ago, I tried to resist, only to find there was nowhere to start—because it hides within Heavenly Dao itself, every time we窥探天机, we're essentially reporting to it!'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, voice trembling: 'So the Tianji Record...' Chen Tianming continued: 'That's right, the Tianji Record is the special shackles it forged for me. It makes each successive writer believe they're foresight the future, but every act of glimpsing helps it correct the chess game, fill in the loopholes. And the reason I chose you is precisely your bloodline—the Tian given to me by that existence ten thousand years ago, passed down through Chen generations—and you are the only person in ten thousand years who can turn this Heavenly Fate back against it!' Mo Xiansheng nearby said in horror: 'So your ten-thousand-year layout was to... cultivate a chess piece capable of devouring Heavenly Dao?' Chen Tianming shook his head: 'Not devour, but fuse—make Chen Ji become the new Heavenly Dao will, completely replacing it!'

text.content: Chen Ji listened, then let out a cold laugh: 'The ancestor speaks beautifully. But have you considered, why should I become your chess piece and become some new Heavenly Dao will?' The benevolent expression on Chen Tianming's face gradually faded, replaced by a superior's coldness: 'Because you have no choice.' He waved his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms flew out on its own, hovering between the two. 'You think the Tianji Record is a divine artifact? Wrong. It was the contract I signed with that existence back then; every writer is merely a continuation of the contract—including you.'

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming revealed the true nature of the Tianji Record—it was not a divine artifact, but a contract. Chen Ji fell into an unprecedented predicament: to accept fate, or fight to the end?

choices.description: Even if the Tianji Record is a contract, I will break it, refuse to be the puppet of any existence
choices.visible_cost: May trigger contract backlash, endangering life
choices.visible_reward: May find the true method to break the局
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record contract backlash is extremely powerful

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly activated all the power within his body, the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment blazed frantically, the contract backlash's power surged like a tide. He spat out a mouthful of blood, yet laughed wildly: 'Good! Good one, contract! Since it wants to trap me, I'll destroy it first!' Chen Tianming's expression changed drastically: 'Stop! If you do this, you—' Before he could finish, the fragment exploded with a thunderous roar, countless shards scattered in all directions, and on Chen Ji's brow center, a brand-new rune was slowly taking shape!

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is a contract, then negotiate with it, use it in my own way
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Chen Tianming's complete layout inheritance

text.content: Chen Ji收起笑容，淡淡道："好，我接受这份契约。但我有一个条件——从今往后，天机录由我来执笔，而非被它执笔。"陈天命盯着他看了许久，忽然放声大笑："好！好！这才是我陈家的种！"笑声渐止，老者的身影开始消散，"记住，天道本源最虚弱的时候，是每万年的天道轮回之日——而那一天，就在三年之后！"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's residual soul drifted out from the fragment, his expression complex as he looked at Chen Ji: "Master, you... saw it all." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade: "You knew, didn't you? From the very beginning, you knew the truth of the Tianji Record, yet you kept it from me all this time." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before finally nodding: "Yes. Because before Chen Tianming perished, he used his final wisp of residual soul to seal my memories. Unless you witnessed him yourself, I could never speak the truth." Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: "What a Chen Tianming, what an ancestor of the Chen family! He truly left nothing to chance." Mo Xiansheng sighed: "He calculated everything, yet overlooked one thing—your fury."

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing into the void that had already returned to stillness, yet the flames of rage in his eyes burned ever fiercer. Ten thousand years ago, his ancestor had been forced into becoming a chess piece, scheming for ten thousand years merely to cultivate a substitute. And ten thousand years later, that so-called Heavenly Origin still regarded him as a mere chess piece. In this moment, an unprecedented fury surged through Chen Ji's heart—not at Chen Tianming's betrayal, but at that high and mighty Heavenly Origin that viewed all living beings as mere grass beneath its feet. He spoke slowly, his voice cold as eternal glacial ice: "Since you all want to treat me as a chess piece... then I shall shatter this entire game, along with the table." Mo Xiansheng bowed and asked: "What does the master intend?" Chen Ji turned around, his eyes gleaming with a dangerous light: "The Heavenly Cycle of three years later... I want to pay a visit to that 'Heavenly Origin'."
